_source: Built mechanically from the facts of CBP ruling N363381 (2026-08-17, held-out Part 102 window final; subject: "RE: The tariff classification, country of origin, marking, and eligibility for preferential treatment under the United States-Mexico-Canada Trade Agreement (“USMCA”) of a forklift dust mop attachment"). Frozen by the D570 rule before any run. CBP held Canada. Components: the D362 materials; part codes: the top D381 held-out suggestion (unverified, D382); the good's code: CBP's (9603.90.8050). Family and name: the family check (machinery_parts, 0.8); name from the subject (D381 rule). Materials with no country left out (8: thread, fork pockets, cross tubes, pivoting boom, neodymium magnet, mounting pins, fasteners, securing chain). Groups: one model call with the production extractor's group rule (groups-f20.jsonl, D630). Plants one per country; operations one per group and plant plus final assembly in Canada. Target Vietnam by the D171 rule counted mechanically; plant capabilities for Vietnam are an assumption. Economics illustrative. D570 set, second pass D630.
